name: coverage-analysis
description: Compute multi-dimensional coverage over a traceability graph: requirements-to-tests, goals-to-E2E, risks-to-controls, NFR-to-implementation, regulatory-clause-to-control. Identifies gaps, heat-maps by artifact type, surfaces false-coverage (tests without assertions, tests duplicating coverage), and proposes prioritized gap-closure actions. Consumes traceability-matrix output.
